responses-copilot.config.title: Responses for Copilot
responses-copilot.config.baseUrl.descrip:
Responses base URL or full endpoint. Default: https://gd.yundu.lol/v1/responses (user supplied). A trailing /responses is kept; otherwise /responses is appended. Include /v1 where your service needs it. Chat Completions is not supported. [Reset to Default](command:responses-copilot.resetBaseUrl)

[Set / Update API Key](command:responses-copilot.setApiKey) · [Clear API Key](command:responses-copilot.clearApiKey)
Custom headers for Responses requests. Use Set API Key for credentials instead of putting them in settings.
responses-copilot.config.maxTokens.descr: Output token cap. 0 uses the model profile limit; a positive integer further limits output without exceeding maxOutputTokens. The picker shows the effective cap.
responses-copilot.config.experimental.st:
**Experimental**: try to pre-activate available tools to reduce changes across turns. May increase input tokens and internal preflight calls. Any cache improvement depends on your backend. Disabled by default.

[Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools)
responses-copilot.config.debugMode.descr:
Controls what diagnostic information Responses for Copilot writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`Responses for Copilot: Show Logs`](command:responses-copilot.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`Responses for Copilot: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:responses-copilot.openRequestDumpsFolder).
responses-copilot.config.debugMode.minim: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
responses-copilot.config.debugMode.metad: Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `Responses for Copilot: Show Logs`.
responses-copilot.config.debugMode.verbo: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
responses-copilot.config.visionModel.des: Retained Vision Proxy setting. The default GPT 6.1 Sol profile uses native image input and needs no proxy.
responses-copilot.config.visionPrompt.de: Retained Vision Proxy description prompt. Does not affect Responses models configured for native image input.
responses-copilot.config.models.descript: Replace the selectable model list. The default GPT 6.1 Sol profile is user supplied; capabilities and limits are not independently verified public model specifications. Enable only capabilities your backend supports. Set [] to hide every model.
responses-copilot.config.models.contextW: Optional total input-plus-output context bound. The effective output allowance is reserved before deriving the input budget, capped by maxInputTokens.
responses-copilot.config.models.canDisab: Set true only when the backend explicitly supports the none reasoning effort. Disabling reasoning is not offered by default.
Responses prompt_cache_key. auto generates a stable hash without prompt plaintext; an empty string omits the field; any other string is used as the key. Cache hits and pricing depend on your backend.
responses-copilot.config.modelIdOverride: Override the API ID for any configured model. Keys are picker model IDs; values are model names sent to the endpoint. This does not add models or change capability limits.
